def transform(grid):
    """For each bottom-row 5 marker, propagate upward along its column.
    Each empty cell takes the color of the nearest nonzero cell below it;
    existing nonzero cells remain unchanged."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h = len(out)
    for c, value in enumerate(out[-1]):
        if value != 5:
            continue
        color = 5
        for r in range(h - 1, -1, -1):
            if out[r][c] != 0:
                color = out[r][c]
            else:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
